race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
race.verdict: SENSATIONAL FILLY holds the clear edge on form and is fancied to build on her recent Leopardstown second and get off the mark. C&D debut third Ladies Gossip also has better days ahead of her and can chase home Paddy Twomey's promising Mehmas filly ahead of stablemate Corsican Night , who warrants a market check on her debut. SENSATIONAL FILLY (FR) LADIES GOSSIP (IRE) CORSICAN NIGHT (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Sensational Filly (7/4), Ladies Gossip (5/2), Corsican Night (11/2), Shivling (13/2), Gradoux (7/1), Bougie Gals (14/1), Saoirse Silk (16/1), Celine Dee (33/1), Knightlight (33/1), Ria's Angel (50/1), Minshara (66/1), Canta Castela (150/1)

past_results.ride_description: In touch, came wide entering straight, headway over 1f out, 3rd 1f out, kept on in 2nd closing stages, no chance with easy winner
Towards rear early, rear of mid-division halfway, pushed along and headway under 2f out, 5th 1f out, ridden and kept on inside final furlong to go 3rd close home
